name: deliver-app-events
job: Send email, webhooks, realtime, or push through Platform Events.

inScope: Submitting a typed message with request identity

tools: Platform Events SDK or runtime API

failureSemantics: A local log line is not delivery; the Operation must reach a terminal with a receipt.

outcome.observable: A typed message was submitted on the Platform Events contract and the Delivery Operation reached a terminal with a receipt.
